en: Allows you to move at reduced speed while sieged and unlocks the activate thrusters ability.<n/><s val="IdleButtonCharge"><c val="FF8000">"Since my self pulling magnet idea didn't work, we'll have to settle with two dropship engines! It's not like we'll need the dropships anyways."<n/>                 -- Dr. Andrew O'Neil</c>
zh: 允许你在架起状态下以降低的速度移动，并解锁启动推进器技能。<n/><s val="IdleButtonCharge"><c val="FF8000">“既然我那个自牵引磁铁的点子行不通，我们只好凑合用两台运输船引擎了！反正我们也用不上那些运输船。”<n/>                 -- 安德鲁·奥尼尔博士</c>

en: Provides short range radar capable of detecting structures and unlocks the flare ability.<n/><s val="IdleButtonCharge"><c val="FF8000">"Since apparently all of our flashlights have gone missing, you'll have to settle for these."<n/>                 -- Sgt. Blackthorn</c>
zh: 提供可探测建筑的短程雷达，并解锁照明弹技能。<n/><s val="IdleButtonCharge"><c val="FF8000">“既然我们的手电筒显然全都失踪了，你只能凑合用这些了。”<n/>                 ——布莱克索恩中士</c>

en: Turns the ares tank into a mobile bunker allowing a passenger to ride and shoot from inside with increased range and unlocks the self destruct ability.<n/><s val="IdleButtonCharge"><c val="FF8000">"By removing the cumbersome and unwieldy oxygen generator, we can fit up to 5 people in here! Eh-Just remember not to breathe fast."<n/>                 -- Engineer Dave</c>
zh: 将阿瑞斯坦克改造成移动地堡，允许一名乘客乘坐并从内部射击，射程提升，同时解锁自毁能力。<n/><s val="IdleButtonCharge"><c val="FF8000">“只要拆掉那台又笨重又难用的氧气发生器，我们这里最多能塞进 5 个人！呃——只要记住别呼吸太快就行。”<n/>                 --工程师戴夫</c>
